combo_label: Barbecues × Musical Instruments × 20th-Century English Choral Music

entries.clue: Fine pale grey remains raked out of the tray the morning after
Benjamin whose War Requiem marked the consecration of Coventry's rebuilt cathedral
Twin-coil magnet under electric strings, cancelling mains buzz
Teardrop body, paired strings, and a shivering tremolo picked in bluegrass
Ruffed, cassocked child singer earning their keep at daily services
Slogan-printed garment tied at the waist to keep fat off a clean shirt
Given out by the human voice rather than played on an instrument
John whose honeyed modern carols conquered Christmas
Lamb cut with a bone in it, quick to cook and easily dried out
Sea snail's whorled home, its point sawn off and blown to summon a crowd
Wax stick with a wick; the citronella kind is sold as an insect deterrent
Amber block a fiddler drags the bow across so the hair will grip
